workload.source: Initial estimate for long multi-turn agent workloads; concurrency from configured maximum batch; token counts are estimates pending goal 12.

measurements.peak_basis: One p300c ASIC: 120 cores, 4096 ops/cycle, 1.35GHz, HiFi4 /4; 512GB/s. Official p300/QuietBox2 specs and tt-perf-report ArchitectureSpec.
measurements.device_window_basis: FW end minus FW start across ALL layer ops, including gaps. Decode is mean of 128 complete per-replay windows; gaps between separate replays excluded.
measurements.assumptions: BF16 weights/activations/cache, HiFi4; dense active work. Useful FLOPs count all linear projections and causal QK/PV, omit small elementwise work. Estimated DRAM: physical operand/output bytes for every ordinary DRAM op once, active KV once, tile cache updates and page metadata; L1 operands excluded. Includes tile padding, excludes redundant per-core reads and cache reuse. BinaryNg hash-cached prefill shapes are replaced by actual decode B<=32 residual/MLP and KV-norm geometry. Weight reference bytes are informational and not added twice. Percentages are estimates, not counters.

ledger.scope: Representative single layers; per-kind entries are alternatives, not simultaneous whole-model allocations.

weights.name: sliding_attention/QKV
weights.copy_reason: Packed QKV improves B32 prefill; separate projections win decode. Both copies validated with full context.

ledger.pool_ownership: Caller allocates page/cache tensors; this stage has no serving pool allocator.
ledger.target_agent_pool_status: Workload estimate only; full-model pool capacity is outside this layer stage.

stage_checker: check_agentic_serving.py has no fused-decoder stage; its full-model/serving checks are not claimed here.
